clips.title: The story
paras: Good Steel is an Alliance quest originating at Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. In the wake of recent conflicts, high-quality metal has become scarce, leaving the camp's woodcutting equipment worn and difficult to replace. Craftsman Hagar Lowe tasks adventurers with delving into Jasperlode Mine to salvage well-crafted pickaxes so their steel can be repurposed.

Following the devastating conflicts that have battered the human kingdoms, high-grade steel has become an increasingly scarce luxury in Elwynn Forest. At Eastvale Logging Camp, daily timber harvesting relies heavily on durable axes, saws, and hardware, but the tools currently available have suffered badly from substandard metal and constant wear. Without reliable shipments coming from Stormwind's foundries, camp craftsmen like Hagar Lowe are forced to find inventive solutions to keep the forestry camp functioning.

To replace worn equipment, Hagar sets his sights on Jasperlode Mine, an abandoned excavation north of the camp. The miners who worked the rich veins before the mine's fall used finely crafted picks forged from an era when steel was plentiful and expertly tempered. Rather than letting those sturdy implements rust away in the dark, adventurers are dispatched to venture into the infested tunnels, recover the abandoned picks, and bring them back to Eastvale so their superior metal can be melted down and repurposed for the camp's lumberjacks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you been to the mine yet?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, very nice. Do you see that shine? Truly, they don't make them like they used to.
